snippet.title: Boeckham's Football Manager - Trailer
snippet.description:
Boeckham's Football Manager is an old-school retro football manager in the style of management games of the 1990s like "The Manager" or "On The Ball". Lead your team through the seasons, shaped by dynamic story events. Develop your club and yourself to gain a reputation and conquer your league and the world.

Demo available on Steam!

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3523140/Boeckhams_Football_Manager/

Detailed current gameplay: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q3C2BI1wwDA
